kind: Read-only static review; no GPU or full CPU rebuild

geometryBasis.reason: C16 city diff adds only foliage hook; no sites, geometry, planting, stairs or vegetationClearAreas changes. Bounds are recomputed from saved C15 actual clearAreas, not a new C16 runtime readback.

townRect.shape: Rounded-rectangle Euclidean distance; AABB corners are not all affected.
townRect.flowerRule: At k=1 the deterministic hash test keeps approximately 25% of otherwise retained meadow instances; not exact count, not density texture edits. Terrain flower tint multiplier is 0.25. Grass tint saturation0.62, RGB scale[.882,.855,.756].

cityFoliage.isolation: M Proxy clones source material once, registers ownedMaterials, clears clipping. Captured original paint+foliage hook and explicit original key closure retained; no recursion or mutation of station/skyline originals.
cityFoliage.scope: City M.foliage props: hedges/shrubs and two procedural garden trees. Other far-house tree materials are not this hook.
cityFoliage.resources: No new geometry/textures, owned clone existing lifetime; dispose only materials/geometries/InstancedMesh instances, no borrowed texture dispose.
cityFoliage.failureGuard: Checks original clump expression exists. color_fragment replacement lacks its own guard, but pinned original foliage and paint hooks retain that exact chunk; no current failure found.
cityFoliage.tint: Before clump modulation, saturation0.62 and RGB[1.03,.98,.86]; hl .1→.16, sh .14→.26. Not global light/exposure or physical height/collision change.

gravel.scope: Both station side and west yards. Other houses/shrine M.gravel names use distinct textures; not shared st-gravel.
gravel.resources: No image/texture clone, upload size, mesh, UV buffer, height or collider change.

transitionFinding.status: Confirmed shader-formula mismatch; visible magnitude not GPU-proven
transitionFinding.chain: createIsland copies terrain fragment string into transition before applyIsland. Existing BANDS updates both; new TOWN only updates terrain. station blend copies transition later, so transition and station edge retain original tint.
transitionFinding.whyClearingDoesNotEliminate: splat R/A density clear removes blades/flower wash, but meadow floor color at terrain.js535-565 is still constructed without multiplying by grass density.
transitionFinding.limits: Final RGB also depends on terrain rock/paving/shore masks, shading and occlusion; no claim of mandatory visible seam at every pixel.
transitionFinding.minimalDirection: Apply same TOWN uniforms and terrain injections to terrain and transition; later station blend naturally inherits, no independent patch required.

limitations: No shader GPU compilation, image assessment, resource disposal execution or C16 geometry rebuild performed.
Meadow prototype lifetime reviewed by another agent, not covered here.
